03 · Method

How to read the comparison

Collocations count word pairs within four tokens on either side of the selected form, within a source line. LogDice ranks association strength. Repeated phrases are exact two- to four-token sequences. Concordance rows show the original file and line so you can check agency and attribution in context.

The comparison describes the supplied sample. Topics, dates, and article formats were not matched. Some files bundle updates and some material overlaps. The shorter-file view tests how much the largest texts influence the results.
